name: Saionji Kyouka
source:
Daughter of a famous family, Kyouka was raised with nothing but the best a girl can have. Popular with the other students, she can't keep her hands off anyone she considers to be cute, whether they be male or female.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yin-Yang!_X-Change_Alternative]Wikipedia[/url]]
